jobs.title: Clinical Research associate II
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management. We are now recruiting Clinical Research Associate II to join our team in Belgium or the Netherlands. This is a remote based position with travel to sites for morning visits. We are looking for candidates based in Belgium or the Netherlands with oncology monitoring experience. About you: You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned. You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game. You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties. You have an impeccable eye for detail. You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them. You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work. You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies. jobs.title: Union Relations Lead / Directeur(rice) du Paritarisme
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions. ⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions). jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US. jobs.title: Pharmacist
jobs.description: The Order Management Associate (Pharmacist) provide support in acknowledgment of orders and documentation support to the Order Management team. This role focuses on acknowledgment logging, data organization, and encoding assistance to ensure smooth workflow and timely order processing. Essential Functions A. Order Encoding and Documentation Support Receive and organize incoming prescriptions and orders files. Ensure prescriptions are properly labeled and stored in digital folders. Maintain organized tracking logs of all incoming orders. Encode approved orders into designated systems (Compounder, trackers, OneDrive). Prepare and organize prescription files (soft and hard copies). Assist in backlog clearance during peak volume day. Prepares other task requires in order management. B. Order Acknowledgment Support Assist in acknowledging orders across platforms under guidance of Order Management Specialist II. Flag incomplete or unclear orders for review Ensure acknowledgment logs are updated in real time. C. Administrative and Reporting Support Assist in preparing weekly OMD reports. Update trackers, dashboards, and monitoring files. Ensure documentation completeness before handover to QA & Logistics. D. Cross Functional Assistance Perform other operationally required tasks assigned by heads. Adhere to company standards and policies at all times.

jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
